summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the US-listed public-company universe for the semiconductor process-tools node. The strongest direct exposures are lithography, wafer-fab equipment, deposition/etch/clean, inspection/metrology/process control, advanced-packaging process control, and semiconductor test. The five candidates below are research candidates only, not buy/sell recommendations. Initial evidence suggests the node is broader than EUV: AI-driven leading-edge logic, HBM, advanced packaging, and yield/throughput pressure map to multiple tool categories. Expanded the US-listed universe around the semiconductor equipment/process-tools chokepoint beyond AI chip designers and foundries. The most relevant direct exposures are diversified wafer-fab equipment, etch/deposition, process-control/metrology/inspection, advanced-packaging process control, and automated test equipment. The evidence supports a cluster bottleneck rather than a single EUV-only bottleneck: SEMI forecasts record equipment sales driven by advanced logic, memory/HBM, and advanced packaging; company filings and releases show AI/HBM/advanced packaging as explicit demand drivers for AMAT, LRCX, KLAC, ONTO, and TER. This is research universe expansion only, not a buy/sell ranking. Expanded the node from EUV lithography into a broader equipment chokepoint cluster: materials engineering, deposition/process tools, process control, advanced packaging metrology, automated test, probe cards, and subsystem inputs. The most relevant US-listed additions are not only large wafer-fab-equipment vendors, but also metrology/test/probe-card and vacuu
